projects.name: TDOT Projects Public Viewer (TDOT test host)
projects.notes: HOST CAVEAT: verified on tspatial.tdot.tn.gov, which TDOT labels as its TEST server. The production copy is the same path on spatial.tdot.tn.gov (https://spatial.tdot.tn.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Roadway_Projects/Projects_Public_Viewer/MapServer/0), but that host timed out on every request from here and is NOT verified; re-test it before use and prefer it if it answers. Content: all TDOT projects from conception to completion. Planned vs under way: PROJECT_STATUS 'ACTIVE' = in development (not yet let), 'LET' = contract awarded, 'CONSTCOMP' = construction complete, 'CLOSED'. CURRENT_BUDGETED_PHASE = PE / LOCATION / ROW / CONST / PAVING; 'ROW' marks projects currently in right-of-way acquisition. CURRENT_PHASE_FED_YR_DATE is the date (epoch ms) of the current phase, not a letting date. PROJECT_BID_AMOUNT is filled only once let; there is no estimate for unlet projects here. Also TERMINI, SCOPE_OF_WORK, ROUTE_NUMBERS, PROGRAM_TYPE, CONTRACTOR, ESTIMATED_COMPLETION_DATE, PROJECT_WEB_LINK, GEOMETRY_STATUS. maxRecordCount 5000.

projects.name: TDOT STIP Projects (TDOT test host)
projects.notes: Same host caveat: this is the copy on TDOT's TEST server (layer is named 'TEST STIP Projects'); production is the same path on spatial.tdot.tn.gov, which timed out from here and is not verified. STIP projects with ESTIMATED_COST, RESPONSIBLE_AGENCY, MPO, ASSOCIATED_TIPS, STIP_ID (null in the sample). No status or date on the layer itself: phase and year are in the related table 1 'Approved Funding' (https://tspatial.tdot.tn.gov/arcgis/rest/services/Roadway_Projects/STIP_Projects/MapServer/1, 1,861 rows: APPROVED_PROJECT_ID, PHASE e.g. 'Const', FUND_CODE, FISCAL_YEAR, FEDERAL_FUNDS, STATE_FUNDS, LOCAL_FUNDS), joined on APPROVED_PROJECT_ID. The sample funding row was fiscal year 2023, so the test copy may hold an older STIP cycle. Table 2 is 'Public Amendments'. maxRecordCount 1000.

parcels_statewide.name: Tennessee Property Boundaries Public Use (TN Comptroller) - 86 of 95 counties
parcels_statewide.restrictions: The layer description says: 'This data is intended for use by state agencies with approved access.' It is nevertheless published without login as 'Public Use'. No statement on commercial use or solicitation.
parcels_statewide.notes: NOT fully statewide. A distinct query on COUNTY_NAME returned 86 counties. Comparing that list with Tennessee's 95 counties, the 9 missing are: Chester, Davidson (Nashville), Hamilton (Chattanooga), Hickman, Knox (Knoxville), Montgomery (Clarksville), Rutherford (Murfreesboro), Shelby (Memphis), Williamson; queries for Davidson, Shelby, Knox, Hamilton and Rutherford each returned 0. Owner name is in OWNER plus OWNER2 (second line, e.g. 'AND WIFE ...'). There is NO mailing address and no value field; LINK_TPAD is a per-parcel link to the Comptroller's assessment web page (not a service). ADDRESS is the site address written street-then-number ('DUNCAN LN 419'). GISLINK is the state parcel key; DEEDAC = deeded acres. maxRecordCount 2000.

parcels_counties.notes: Metro Nashville 'Ownership Parcels'. ParID / STANPAR are alternative parcel ids; LandAppr, ImprAppr, TotlAppr appraised and LandAssd / TotlAssd assessed values; SalePrice, OwnDate; LUDesc land use; PropCity, PropZip.

parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found for this item (its licence field is empty; it is published by the City of Murfreesboro GIS manager's account, GBLee2). Rutherford County's own GIS disclaimer was read (https://rutherfordcountytn.gov/gis): warranty and liability only, e.g. 'Any user of this information accepts the same AS IS, WITH ALL FAULTS, and assumes all responsibility for the use or misuse or interpretation of this data and information'; it states no limit on commercial use, resale or solicitation. The Tennessee Comptroller's parcel page says Rutherford is 'NOT MAINTAINED BY THE TENNESSEE OFFICE OF THE COMPTROLLER OF THE TREASURY AND CANNOT BE SHARED BY OUR OFFICE'.
parcels_counties.notes: 'Parcel Data' feature service, layer 1 'Parcels', described as 'Comprehensive parcel and special interest property data for Rutherford County, Tennessee'; edited 2026-11-04, YearID 2027. Whole county (Smyrna and Murfreesboro rows seen). Owner2, Owner3; CAMAACCT / UserAccount assessor account; TotalLandValue, TotalBuildingValue, TotalAssessedValue, DEEDACRES, SaleDate. Layer 0 of the same service is the 15,724-point 'Special Interest' layer noted earlier. The county's own service maps.rutherfordcountytn.gov/ags03/.../Assessor/ParcelOwners asks for a token.

parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found (the service and its item record carry no licence or description text; no City of Chattanooga or Hamilton County data-terms page for this layer was found). The Tennessee Comptroller's parcel page says Hamilton is 'NOT MAINTAINED BY THE TENNESSEE OFFICE OF THE COMPTROLLER OF THE TREASURY AND CANNOT BE SHARED BY OUR OFFICE'.
parcels_counties.notes: City of Chattanooga Public Works server, layer 'Parcels' (database name chattgis.GIS_ADMIN.Parcels; the same data is also at .../WaterQuality/CityCountyParcels/MapServer/0 under the name 'ChattanoogaHamiltonParcels'). PARTIAL COVERAGE LIKELY: 86,104 rows is about half of what Hamilton County should hold, so this is probably the city and nearby area only; not measured. OWNERNAME1 / OWNERNAME2 are space-padded and need trimming; one row reads 'Update in Progress'. MASTNAME is the mailing street line. LANDVALUE, BUILDVALUE, ASSVALUE, DEEDACRES, SALE1DATE also present. Update date not published. Hamilton County's own server (mapsdev.hamiltontn.gov) timed out.

parcels_counties.notes: STALE AND PARTIAL: City of Franklin ArcGIS Online 'Parcels', last edited 2019-07-29, 32,769 rows: the Franklin area only, not all of Williamson County. OWNER2; GISLINK; LEGAL_ACRE; land_market, imp_value, total_assess. Fallback only. Williamson County's own server (arcgis2.williamson-tn.org) timed out; no county layer verified.

summary: Projects: TDOT publishes the right layers (all projects with status and current phase; STIP with cost and funding years) but only the copy on TDOT's test server answered; production timed out. Parcels: the Comptroller layer gives owner names (no mailing address) for 86 counties; of the 9 missing metro counties only Davidson is verified, with owner and mailing address.
parcels_counties_not_found: The other large counties missing from the state layer could not be verified: Shelby (gis.shelbycountytn.gov answered 403; a Memphis layer requires a token), Knox (www.kgis.org timed out), Hamilton (server error 522), Rutherford (county server returned a non-JSON page; a Murfreesboro layer found covers only 15,724 special-interest points).
parcels_second_pass: Second pass 2026-11-17 (parcels only). Statewide: nothing new; the Comptroller layer on file still stands. Terms now read for it at https://comptroller.tn.gov/office-functions/pa/gisredistricting/redistricting-and-land-use-maps/parcel-data.html: 'Any company or organization can use, save, and maintain the shapefile data for any use case, including consumption in a commercial application/software or for historical purposes.' The same page says: 'We do not offer bulk or historical downloads, nor any recurring extracts or other automated downloads' and 'We do not provide statewide extracts of either assessment data or parcel shapefile data.' Those sentences are about the requested shapefile download, not expressly about the ArcGIS layer, whose own description still reads 'intended for use by state agencies with approved access'. The page also confirms the nine counties outside the state system: 'CHESTER, DAVIDSON, HAMILTON, HICKMAN, KNOX, MONTGOMERY, RUTHERFORD, SHELBY, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES ARE NOT MAINTAINED BY THE TENNESSEE OFFICE OF THE COMPTROLLER OF THE TREASURY AND CANNOT BE SHARED BY OUR OFFICE.' Added Rutherford (good), Hamilton (Chattanooga server, probably partial), Williamson (Franklin only, 2019). Davidson was already on file. WILSON and SUMNER: no county layer found (county host names did not resolve; nothing in the ArcGIS Online catalog); both are inside the Comptroller layer, which has owner names but no mailing address. NOT FOUND: SHELBY - gis.shelbycountytn.gov answers 403, the assessor host timed out, Memphis's ArcGIS Online organization has no parcel layer, Collierville's 'Certified Parcels' has no owner fields. KNOX - www.kgis.org timed out again and maps.knoxmpc.org presents an expired certificate (not bypassed).
